'''567 East''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] space. A group of adventures berthed their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the docking bay, and met [[Lazarus Armand]] there after the latter contracted them to transport cargo to the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system]].
